units: <cite ref="Menachot 53b:4">Men. 53ᵇ</cite> <he>יבא זה וכ׳</he> let this one come and receive this &c.; <he>זה זה משה</he> ‘this one’ that means Moses; <he>זאת זו התורה</he> ‘this’—that means the Law.
Gen. R. s. 4 לגיון זה this legion; a. v. fr.—זֶהוּ = זה הוא, this is.
<cite ref="Shabbat 40b:8">Sabb. 40ᵇ</cite> <he>הפשרו זהו בישולו</he> (also <he>זה הוא</he>) warming it is the cooking of it, v. <cite ref="E00772"><he>הֶפְשֵׁר</he></cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 8:4">Gitt. VIII, 4</cite> <he>אי זֹהו</he> Y. ed. (Mish. <cite ref="A01194"><he>אֵיזֶהוּ</he></cite>); a. v. fr.
